{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of sites after deduplication
sites = data_dedup['site'].unique()
print(f'Unique sites after deduplication: {sorted(sites)}')

# Compute response rate per site
table = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)
print(f'Response rates by site:\n{table}')"}
